about: Templates of 'satk shader new'. fx/lua = files in this folder ('//@satk:snippet <name>' lines take snippets/<name>.fxh); select = default world textures (kind, names or apply patterns; null = the user must choose); values = [parameter, default, comment] set from Lua; update/setup/teardown = Lua lines of the glue.

car_paint.about: car paint reflection: sky reflection with a Fresnel falloff and a sun highlight on vehicle paint
update: local tr, tg, tb, br, bg, bb = getSkyGradient()

wet_roads.about: wet, shiny roads: darker asphalt with a sky reflection and a sun highlight that follow the rain
values: sky reflection strength at full wetness
consts: local MIN_WETNESS = 0.0   -- 0.6 = always shiny roads, 0 = only in the rain
update: local tr, tg, tb, br, bg, bb = getSkyGradient()

water.about: animated water: scrolling ripples, a sky reflection and a colour tint on the water texture
values: tint colour (r, g, b) and its strength
update: local tr, tg, tb, br, bg, bb = getSkyGradient()

texture_replace.about: world texture replacement: draw one image instead of the selected world textures

sky_fog.about: sky and fog tint: a warm world tint, a distance haze and a matching sky gradient
values: colour multiplier (r, g, b) and its strength
setup: setSkyGradient(SKY_TOP[1], SKY_TOP[2], SKY_TOP[3], SKY_BOTTOM[1], SKY_BOTTOM[2], SKY_BOTTOM[3])

ped_shading.about: ped shading tweak: saturation, contrast, brightness and a tint of peds (pixel shader only, skinning untouched)
values: colour multiplier (r, g, b) and its strength

post_process.about: simple post-process: colour grading and a vignette over the screen, HUD untouched
values: colour multiplier (r, g, b) and its strength
